documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter/Half Year Ended 30 September 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for financial year 2026, marking a 12% increase over the previous year, driven largely by the water business. Consolidated EBITDA for the full year stood at Rs. 51 crores and profit before tax at Rs. 45 crores, both up 7% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

guidance.claim: Management stated that they hope H2 would be growing at a steady rate.
guidance.quote: So we hope H2 would be we also be growing at a steady rate.

guidance.claim: Management hopes that the second half, H2, would perform still better in construction chemicals.
guidance.quote: and we hope that the second-half that is H2 would be performed still more better.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook continues to remain positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a strong order book for specialty chemicals and a robust enquiry pipeline in the Water BU.
demand_outlook.quote:
Strong order book for specialty chemicals
120.31
Robust enquiry pipeline

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed 18% stronger demand in Construction Chemicals.
Management stated that they are seeing a growth in construction chemical business from September onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: So from September onwards we are seeing a growth in construction chemical business, our material cost, our gross profit margins are stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the water treatment chemicals market would grow at a CAGR of 5.2% for the next five years.
demand_outlook.quote: That is $1 billion. And the recent study and research shows that this would grow at the CAJR of 5.2% for the next five years, but the area in which we operate, the domain in which we operate in cooling water treatment and all the space is around Rs. 1500 to Rs. 1600 CR right now and this would grow at a pace of around 7 to 8%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that key materials used in their operations are based on metals like zinc and molybdenum, which have been tracking up.
margins_costs.quote: A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that. All of them had been tracking up.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted material costs increase due to war impact and some volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

margins_costs.claim: Management attributed the increase in EBITDA for the second quarter to good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that they are starting the financial year with a strong order book for the chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the water business is entering the year with a strong order book for chemicals and equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that equipment and systems deliveries are on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that in the water business unit they have almost 100 plus crores of new order book apart from the regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: Management specified that almost 85 to 90 crores of the water order book is in chemicals and 10 to 12 crores is in equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that material costs started increasing from the end of February and March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that 30% of their total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted force majeure until declared by the government two weeks ago.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management mentioned a prolonged monsoon affecting Construction Chemicals activity, which later picked up post monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they expect to invoice 50% of the new order book in the 3rd and 4th quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So that's this order book more or less would be invoiced 50% of them in 3rd, 3rd and fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are looking at about four years to hit the 1000 crore milestone.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
